Approach 1 keeps one parameter set for all three modes. Configuration TM-P0441-F056 gives the best combined fit. EWP and LCOE are close to the paper in Mode 1, LCOE in all modes, and Mode 3 is close on all three. DPSP is too low in Modes 1 and 2.

Approach 2 picks the best parameters for each mode separately. Every value improves on the teacher's original, and DPSP no longer gets worse in Modes 1 and 2. The cost is three different parameter sets instead of one consistent model. Mode 3 uses the same physical settings as Approach 1, so its plot is the same; only the financial settings differ.
